skill_tags: Finding Areas of Composite Circular Regions

hints: Set up the equations for arc length $s = r\theta = 9.6$ and sector area $A = \frac{1}{2} r^2 \theta = 76.8$.
Divide the sector area by the arc length to find $r$: $\frac{\frac{1}{2} r^2 \theta}{r\theta} = \frac{76.8}{9.6} \implies \frac{1}{2} r = 8 \implies r = 16\text{ cm}$.
Find the area of triangle $OAB = \frac{1}{2} r^2 \sin\theta$ and subtract it from the sector area to find the shaded segment area.
walkthrough:
Relate the given arc length and sector area to determine radius $r$ and angle $\theta$:
$$s = r\theta = 9.6$$
$$\text{Area of sector } OAB = \frac{1}{2} r^2 \theta = 76.8$$

Substitute $r\theta = 9.6$ into the sector area equation:
$$\frac{1}{2} r (r\theta) = 76.8 \implies \frac{1}{2} r (9.6) = 76.8 \implies 4.8 r = 76.8 \implies r = 16\text{ cm}$$
$$\theta = \frac{9.6}{16} = 0.6\text{ radians}$$

Calculate the area of triangle $OAB$:
$$\text{Area of } \triangle OAB = \frac{1}{2} r^2 \sin\theta = \frac{1}{2}(16^2)\sin(0.6) = 128\sin(0.6) \approx 128(0.56464) \approx 72.274\text{ cm}^2$$

Subtract the triangle area from the sector area to find the shaded area:
$$\text{Shaded Area} = \text{Sector Area} - \text{Area of } \triangle OAB = 76.8 - 72.274 = 4.526 \approx 4.53\text{ cm}^2$$

ai_rubric.Circular Measure - Angle in Radians: Solves $r\theta = 9.6$ and $\frac{1}{2}r^2\theta = 76.8$ to find $r = 16$ cm and $\theta = 0.6$ rad.
ai_rubric.Finding Areas of Composite Circular Regi: Calculates $\triangle OAB$ area $128\sin(0.6) \approx 72.27$ and finds shaded area $76.8 - 72.27 = 4.53\text{ cm}^2$.

hints: The perimeter of the shaded region consists of the arc $AB$ and the straight chord $AB$.
Calculate the chord length $AB$ using $AB = 2r\sin\left(\frac{\theta}{2}\right) = 2(16)\sin(0.3)$ (or the cosine rule).
Add the chord length to the arc length $9.6$ cm.
walkthrough:
Calculate the chord length $AB$ using the isosceles triangle formula with $r = 16$ and $\theta = 0.6$:
$$AB = 2r\sin\left(\frac{\theta}{2}\right) = 2(16)\sin(0.3) = 32\sin(0.3) \approx 32(0.29552) \approx 9.4566\text{ cm}$$

Sum the arc length and chord length to find the perimeter of the shaded segment:
$$\text{Perimeter} = \text{Arc } AB + \text{Chord } AB = 9.6 + 9.4566 \approx 19.06 \approx 19.1\text{ cm}$$

ai_rubric.Calculating Perimeters: Calculates chord $AB = 32\sin(0.3) \approx 9.46$ and sums with arc length $9.6$ to get $19.1$ cm.
